query:
SELECT count(*) AS "jobs!",
                      coalesce(sum((SELECT count(*) FROM job_items i
                                    WHERE i.job_id = j.id AND i.state = 'queued')), 0)::bigint
                          AS "items!"
               FROM jobs j
               WHERE j.api_key_id = $1 AND j.state IN ('queued', 'running', 'paused')
